verdict.rationale: dlt provides a first-party dbt runner (dlt-docs-8/30/41) that lets you invoke dbt transformations directly within the same Python pipeline script right after the load step, rather than via an external schedule, and dltHub's transformation feature auto-generates dbt models from the freshly loaded pipeline schema (dlt-docs-16/34/71) with cross-db compatibility (dlt-docs-67). missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the dbt runner reliably fires post-load in production, and explicit examples showing event-driven (not timer-based) orchestration end-to-end.
